verdict.rationale: Mercury's own marketing claims native sync with QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite plus AI-powered automations to close the books faster, so a first-party ERP integration exists. Nothing documents that the sync is real-time, that it runs in both directions, or how it replaces manual journal entries. The webhooks and REST API are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of real-time sync cadence, bidirectional data flow, journal-entry/category mapping details, first-party integration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
